subject: Taxes
title: Why Tax Revolts Happen
description: A short lesson to help you apply Why Tax Revolts Happen.

hook.text: Tax revolts aren't about the amount—they're about three things: fairness, consent, and trust.

buildup.text: Fairness: people accept taxes when the burden is shared equally. Exempt the rich and the poor revolt.

discovery.text: Consent: people need a voice. Every revolt from the Magna Carta to Boston demanded representation before taxation.

twist.text: Trust: people tolerate high taxes if they see results. Scandinavians accept 50% rates because services are excellent.

climax.text: Tax revolts are predictable. They follow a formula: unfairness plus voicelessness plus distrust equals rebellion.

punchline.text: Unfair + voiceless + distrusted = revolt. The formula never changes.

quiz.question: What three conditions must be present to prevent tax revolts?
options: Low rates, simple forms, quick refunds
